verdict.rationale: Digits documents its own Connect API for programmatic access to the ledger, so it can be driven without the UI. The API has idempotent batch sync, webhooks, a resettable demo sandbox for testing, and OpenAPI-based client generation. However, authentication is documented only as an OAuth authorization-code grant that requires a user to authorize, and nothing addresses CI runners or unattended operation. missing for 10: documented non-interactive/service-account auth (e.g. client credentials or API keys), an official CLI or CI integration guidance, and independent hands-on corroboration of headless automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: The Digits Connect API gives you programmatic access to the AGL® — our AI-native general ledger.
Idempotence and deduplication is handled via the external_id field

The Digits Connect API uses OAuth 2.0 with the authorization code grant type
